title: Agent hook
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Spawns a subagent (Read/Grep/Glob, up to 50 turns) to verify a condition and return `{"ok": true|false, "reason": "..."}`. No `continueOnBlock` and no `impossible`; behaves like a prompt hook with continueOnBlock true. Not supported on PermissionRequest or on command/http/mcp_tool-only events.

type.description: Handler type: `agent` runs an agentic verifier.
type.title: Type

prompt.description: Prompt describing what to verify. `$ARGUMENTS` is replaced by the hook input JSON; escape a literal dollar as `\$` (`\$1.00` renders as `$1.00`).
prompt.title: Prompt

model.description: Model used for the verification. Defaults to the model Claude Code uses for background functionality.
model.title: Model

timeout.description: Seconds before the handler is canceled. Default 60 for agent hooks.
timeout.title: Timeout

statusMessage.description: Custom spinner message displayed while the handler runs.
statusMessage.title: Status Message

once.description: If true, the hook is removed after its first successful run (a failed, exit-2 or timed-out run keeps it). Only honored for hooks declared in skill frontmatter; ignored in settings files and agent frontmatter.
once.title: Once

if.description: Permission-rule-syntax filter (exactly one rule, e.g. `Bash(git *)`, `Edit(*.ts)`, `PowerShell(Remove-Item *)`); the handler only runs when the tool call matches. Evaluated only on PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest and PermissionDenied; on any other event a handler with `if` never runs. There is no `&&`/`||`/list syntax: use one handler per condition. Best-effort filter, not a security boundary.
if.title: If

examples.prompt: Verify that all unit tests pass. $ARGUMENTS
